description:
✔️ East Nashville location — minutes to Downtown & Grand Ole Opry
✔️ Third-floor condo with city views
✔️ 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms — sleeps up to 7
✔️ Open concept living with smart TV
✔️ Full kitchen with Keurig and island seating
✔️ Free on-site parking and community fire pit

The space
• Modern third-floor condo with bright open living spaces
• Open living room with smart TV and comfortable seating
• Full kitchen with dining table seating 4 and island seating 2
• Community outdoor space with fire pit
• Easy access to East Nashville restaurants, breweries, shopping, and Downtown

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Open concept living room with smart TV
• Comfortable seating for gathering after a day exploring Nashville
• Community outdoor fire pit and seating area
• City views from the third-floor unit
• Elevator access within the building

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 7)
• This home includes 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.
• Bedroom 1 (Primary) — King bed; smart TV; walk-in closet; ensuite bath with dual vanity, soaking tub, and walk-in shower
• Bedroom 2 — Full-over-full bunk bed with twin trundle; smart TV; chair
• Baths — Primary ensuite with dual vanity, soaking tub, and walk-in shower; second full bath with tub/shower combo

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with stainless appliances and basic cookware/serveware
• Keurig coffee maker
• Dining table seating 4; island seating 2
• Cookware, dishes, utensils, and glassware provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• Private washer and dryer
• Smart TVs in the living room and both bedrooms
• High-speed WiFi
• We provide bedding, towels, and a small starter set of essentials
• Elevator access

📍 Location Highlights
• East Nashville — restaurants, breweries, coffee shops, and shopping nearby
• Downtown Nashville — approximately 15 minutes
• Grand Ole Opry — approximately 10 minutes
• Close to Broadway, Nissan Stadium, and popular Nashville attractions

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Parking: Free parking lot located behind the building
• Elevator available from parking area to the unit
• Early check-in and late checkout require prior approval and may incur a fee
• Shared outdoor amenities are managed by the HOA and availability cannot be guaranteed
• Check-in 4:00 PM; checkout 10:00 AM
